== Summary ==
Card back of Decipher's ''The Lord of the Rings Trading Card Game'' (2001). Free Peoples and Shadow cards share this back; alignment is marked on the face.

Source: [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:The_Lord_of_the_Rings_Trading_Card_Game_cardback.jpg File:The Lord of the Rings Trading Card Game cardback.jpg], Wikipedia (uploaded by Leitmotiv, 14 October 2021). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20251224153727/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:The_Lord_of_the_Rings_Trading_Card_Game_cardback.jpg Internet Archive]. Image: [https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/c/c4/The_Lord_of_the_Rings_Trading_Card_Game_cardback.jpg upload.wikimedia.org]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20251119170146/https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/c/c4/The_Lord_of_the_Rings_Trading_Card_Game_cardback.jpg Internet Archive].

Used on [[SWCCG 2nd Edition]] and [[The Lord of the Rings Trading Card Game]].
